subject: prd/implement-now
statement: When a ready task's originating plan names a feature's approved e2e design doc in the plan's own governing-document header, the executor shall establish that e2e origin before claim from that recorded reference — never by inference over charter prose — resolve the task to exactly one scenario or to the harness slot in that document, and carry the resolved basis into the attempt, adding no e2e-specific task type and no additional required charter field.
rationale: e2e tasks are ordinary tracker tasks by upstream contract, so the origin must be read from a recorded machine-readable reference in a field the plan class already requires; inferring it from prose is exactly the free-form cross-boundary signal AP-6 forbids, and it cannot deliver the exclusivity this row states
fit_criterion: in a fixture repo carrying both a feature-implementation plan and an e2e plan for the same feature, every e2e task resolves to exactly one scenario or the harness slot and every non-e2e task resolves to none; a plan whose header names no e2e design doc yields zero e2e classifications regardless of charter wording; the task and charter schemas are byte-unchanged; an unresolvable or ambiguous basis refuses under UB-14
